{"risk": 3, "reason": "Refactors indexing base class to move BuildIndexAsync handler invocation and culture-filtering into overridable virtual methods, so any other subclasses of NamedIndexingService (in-core or third-party) relying on GetBuildDocumentIndexAsync's previous contract (handlers invoked inside it, non-null return implying trackable) could silently change behavior, e.g. duplicate/missing handler calls or documents being indexed/skipped differently."}
